headline: Amalgamation/Merger - Tata Steel Limited
summary: Tata Steel Limited merger/amalgamation: Tata Steel Limited has informed the Exchange about  Effective Date  of the Scheme of Amalgamation amongst Tata Steel Limited and Rujuvalika Investments Limited, wholly owned subsidiary, and their respective shareholders
